title: Fix loop restart causing brief flash to next line
description: In Loop mode, when a line finishes and loops back to its start, there's sometimes a brief visual flash showing the next line before it snaps back to the current line. This happens because the time-based line detection briefly shows the wrong line during the seek operation. The existing isLoopSeekingRef and targetLineIndexRef logic isn't fully preventing this.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Investigate timing of loop restart seek vs time update events
Ensure activeLineIndex doesn't change during loop restart seek
Test loop mode with multiple lines to verify no visual flash occurs
Consider using a longer timeout or different approach to prevent flash
